content.comment_body: Hello, I am facing a challenge with configuring the TSAP parameters for [product_name] and [product_name] controllers. I have previously set up communication between eight [product_name] modules and one PLC, using different TSAP settings for each local device. Now, I am uncertain about how to set TSAP values if I need to connect two PLCs to two [product_name] controllers. Could someone provide a sample or guide on how to handle this setup? I am looking to achieve this using one integrated program file, where PLC 1 connects to [product_name] 1 and PLC 2 to [product_name] 2. Thank you in advance.
Since the integrated program file cannot be opened with the [product_name] software, it may be more effective to post your technical question in the relevant integrated platform conference section.
Alright, thank you for your advice.

This topic has been closed because the same question was posted twice. The duplicate thread regarding communication between [product_name] modules and controllers is available within the conference for [product_name] engineering software. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing difficulty in configuring TSAP settings required for communication between multiple [product_name] modules and controllers using an integrated engineering program. Specifically, the user is unsure how to handle TSAP assignments for networking specific modules with corresponding controllers. Another noted issue is software incompatibility, especially the inability to open engineering project files with the [product_name] software.
